Drivers! Everyone! Please listen to
Dorara's request, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000123_10_msg0002
rows.name:
If... if you don't mind, please be
friends with Dorara, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000123_10_msg0003
rows.name:
Laura-sama and all of you are elite
Drivers, even awarded knighthoods.
Dorara looks up to you, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000123_10_msg0004
rows.name:
So I want to hear lots more stories,
mo! I want us to become even closer,
mo!

rows.label: tlk70000123_10_msg0005
rows.name:
Mo!? Is that okay, mo!? Yay, mooo!
Dorara is so happy, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000123_10_msg0006
rows.name:
Dorara will become a kind Driver like
all of you, mo! Let's get along from
now on, mo!
